claim_type: Credited prior-theorem coverage with an authored proof repair and separate AI-assisted mathematical audit.
required_scope: Connected reductive G in the original tamely split, minuscule GH category.
Connected reduced affine diagram and one of the thirteen classified affine Coxeter quadruples.
Basic designated length-zero representative τ, θ=Int(τ)σ, and the actual rational group J=G(L)^θ.
K=S\{v} omits one σ-fixed vertex and uses connected parahorics.
Individual refined BT pieces iY(w), indexed by J/(J∩P_{S\Σ_w}); entire EO unions are not the compared pieces.

Equality on geometric points; prior scheme/perfect-scheme and closure conclusions only within their already established ranges.
Literal direct products factor; factor-permuting disconnected data are excluded.

invariant_subset_binding.general_formula: I(K,x,θ) is the largest θ-stable subset of {j∈K\P : s_j commutes with every s_i for i∈P}. Equivalently C ∩ ⋂_{m∈Z} θ^m(K), where C is the commutant outside P.
